capabilities: Add buttons for any command to the mobile navigation bar
Reorder buttons with up and down controls
Keep a separate layout for phone and tablet
Pin the first or last button while the bar scrolls
extras: Device type is detected at Obsidian startup, so rotation, Split View and Stage Manager do not switch layouts until a restart. The plugin uses undocumented Obsidian parts, so an Obsidian update may break it until the plugin is updated.
problem: Obsidian's mobile navigation bar is fixed, so you cannot choose which commands appear, in what order, or use the bar on tablets.
summary: Builds the mobile navigation bar from any commands and icons, with separate layouts for phone and tablet.
